reshard_concatenate_files: run the reshard function to concatenate multiple input files into a single output file with optional cleanup
fast_reshard_concatenate_no_recompress: run the fast_reshard function to concatenate files without re-compressing for faster but larger output
determine_groups_by_size: run determine_groups to split input files into groups based on a target size threshold
get_index_path: run get_index to compute the index file path for a given data file
review_reshard_cleanup_options: review the reshard function free_original and rm_original options for disk space management
